import axiosInstance from"core/services/api/axiosInstance";const base_url=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL;const API_URL=`${base_url}departments`;// Get user departments
const getDepartments=async access_token=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${access_token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.get(API_URL,config);return response.data;};// Delete user department
const deleteDepartment=async(departmentId,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.delete(API_URL+'/'+departmentId,config);return response.data;};const updateDepartment=async(departmentId,departmentData,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.put(API_URL+'/'+departmentId,departmentData,config);return response.data;};// Create new department
const createDepartment=async(departmentData,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL,departmentData,config);return response.data;};const batchDeleteDepartments=async(departmentIds,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL+'/batch-delete',departmentIds,config);return response.data;};const departmentService={createDepartment,getDepartments,deleteDepartment,updateDepartment,batchDeleteDepartments};export default departmentService;
